document_entry_without_explicit_executio.meaning: A document analysed with no explicitly supplied execution entry is analysed as if a fresh tclsh/dialect interpreter runs it: builtins are original unless the file itself (or a proven source-order predecessor) redefines them. Unknown runtime history remains only when a caller explicitly supplies an unknown entry.
document_entry_without_explicit_executio.contract_change: docs/design/contracts/naming-consumer-matrix.md row 'Supplied source entry correspondence' changes from 'Native or unsupported axes retain unknown runtime history' accordingly.

ci_dispatch.meaning: Dispatch ci.yml (workflow_dispatch) on work with rust_tests_runner=hosted to obtain the exact full failure inventory; the local inventory is stopped.
